summary: The American Energy Act amends the Mineral Leasing Act to require continued processing of drilling permit applications on valid leases despite pending lawsuits (unless a court has vacated the lease), sets a four-year term for new permits, and bars courts from vacating or enjoining oil and gas lease sales or awards except upon a finding of imminent substantial environmental harm with no other remedy.
